findingDetails.title: spec.md Files to Change omits the README and the Hermes copy the commit updates
findingDetails.case: the commit changes assets/scripts/README.md (version 1.0.0.8 to 1.0.1.0 plus the verify-doc-claims row rewrite) and the generated .hermes SKILL.md version line, but the frozen Files to Change table names neither
findingDetails.evidence: git show --stat b6eef4ebbb lists eight files; the spec table rows at spec.md:90-94 list the two guards, two tests, SKILL.md and changelog only; plan.md:76 release row likewise names SKILL.md and changelog only
findingDetails.userImpact: an implementer following the frozen list ships the D4 change without the README row that explains it; CHK-040 sync is the last net
findingDetails.scopeProof: eight-file commit stat minus the five listed change targets leaves exactly assets/scripts/README.md and the generated Hermes mirror
findingDetails.recommendation: add a Files to Change row for assets/scripts/README.md and note the generated Hermes mirror on the release row during T012
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a decision record declaring generated mirrors and folder READMEs outside the Files to Change contract

findingDetails.title: Two live docs still describe the surfaces rule as a fixed three-surface check
findingDetails.case: after D4 the doc-claims surfaces rule derives its count from mode-registry.json, yet SKILL.md:175 and scripts/README.md:13 still say every surface count matches the three-surface hub, and the generated Hermes copy repeats it at :180
findingDetails.evidence: the commit rewrote the same sentence in assets/scripts/README.md:77 to matches the surface modes in mode-registry.json; verify-doc-claims.cjs:324 derives declared from the registry modes and :46 matches only the unhyphenated N surfaces form, so the hyphenated stale sentence is not self-detected
findingDetails.userImpact: an adopter reads SKILL.md or the scripts README and concludes the completion gate still requires three surfaces, the misconception D4 removes; no runtime effect
findingDetails.scopeProof: rg -n over .skilled/skills/sk-code for the three-surface vocabulary returns the updated row plus these two live sites; the hub sentence at .skilled/skills/sk-code/SKILL.md:40 is a separate correct statement
findingDetails.recommendation: rephrase both sites to the registry-derived wording and regenerate the Hermes mirror
findingDetails.confidence: high on text, medium on impact
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a documented decision scoping D4's no-text clause to verify-doc-claims.cjs only

findingDetails.title: REQ-006 doctor clause has no acceptance-criteria expression
findingDetails.case: REQ-006 requires tests fail-before/pass-after, one release and the sk-code doctor 13d passing, but AC-006's Then clause covers only the first two
findingDetails.evidence: spec.md:116 carries the doctor clause; acceptance-criteria.md:59 omits it and cites goal.md criteria 3 and 5, while the doctor check lives in goal criterion 1, cited by AC-001
findingDetails.userImpact: someone verifying AC-006 alone could mark REQ-006 Met without rerunning the doctor; evidence mapping is ambiguous
findingDetails.scopeProof: all six AC rows read; only AC-006 maps REQ-006
findingDetails.recommendation: extend AC-006 or cite goal criterion 1 there during T012
findingDetails.confidence: high on text, medium on impact
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: a documented decision that acceptance rows need not mirror every requirement clause
